title: Smoky Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Dutch-Style lamb stew that's perfect for a cold winter's night. This keto-friendly recipe is packed with smoky goodness and tender lamb.
instructions: Brown the lamb shoulder in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the sliced bacon to the pot and cook until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the pot and set it aside with the lamb.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced carrots and celery to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the browned lamb, bacon, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Stir in the Dutch mustard and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
